page: Google Cloud Platform c4n-highmem-16-lssd is a memory-optimized server instance belonging to the c4n family. It features 16 dedicated vCPUs based on the x86_64 architecture. The system is equipped with 124.0 GB of system memory, providing a resource density of 7.75 GB of RAM per core.

This instance includes integrated local storage consisting of 805 GB of NVMe SSD capacity distributed across two local solid-state drives. The server does not include any graphics processing units and does not provide complimentary public IPv4 addresses.

From a qualitative cost-efficiency perspective, the c4n-highmem-16-lssd offers a high ratio of memory and local NVMe storage relative to its 16 dedicated vCPUs, making it suitable for workloads requiring fast local data access and substantial memory capacity. Appropriate workloads for this configuration include in-memory databases, caching layers, data analytics, and transactional databases that benefit from low-latency local NVMe storage.
description: Google Cloud Platform c4n-highmem-16-lssd is an x86_64 architecture server instance within the c4n family, configured with 16 dedicated vCPUs and 124.0 GB of RAM. This configuration yields a memory-to-vCPU ratio of 7.75 GB per core. The instance features 805 GB of local NVMe SSD storage across two drives, providing high-speed local read and write capabilities. It does not include GPU accelerators or complimentary public IPv4 addresses. The high memory density combined with local NVMe SSD storage makes this server suitable for memory-intensive applications, database hosting, caching layers, and data processing tasks that require fast local storage access without the need for dedicated graphics hardware.
